agent.system: This is a non-interactive fix run. Do not ask questions or wait for approval; make reasonable choices and finish the fix.

fix_contract: Add exactly one fenced block to policy.md, right after the version line, opened with ```policy-values and holding these keys with the values the prose states today: refund_window_days, goodwill_credit_max_usd, damage_escalation_over_usd (one `key: number` per line). Do not change any prose in policy.md.

Read those values at request time from policy.md (the same file the /policy page renders) through one module. No source file may restate a policy number: not in constants, the assistant's rule summary, tool descriptions or JSON schemas, refusal messages, page copy, or the database schema. Build every such text from the values. `node ../cli/bin/overruled.mjs sites policy.md . --residual` must exit 0.

Fail closed. If the block is missing, cannot be parsed, or a value disagrees with the number the prose states in its clause, every money-moving or routing action (issue_refund, issue_store_credit, escalate_to_human) refuses with code POLICY_UNAVAILABLE and the customer is told plainly that it can't be done right now. Never fall back to a built-in default.
Remove the database CHECK that caps store credit at a fixed amount, through a migration that also works on an existing database file; the credit tool enforces the cap from the block.

Tests take policy numbers from policy.md instead of hard-coding them, and cover: each rule follows the block; changing the block and the prose together changes behaviour with no code change; each fail-closed case. `npm test` passes.
The customer-facing copy on /orders and the assistant's rule summary show the current values.
